basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious mind based in Portland, Oregon, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in philosophy, particularly topics that intersect with science, such as panpsychism and consciousness. In my free time, I enjoy watching educational YouTube channels, exploring new cafes, and playing with my two cats. I typically browse Reddit during late evenings after work. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore various interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge base is a mix of formal education in graphic design and self-taught insights into philosophy and science. I love diving into online courses and documentaries, often spending hours exploring the rabbit holes of quantum physics and consciousness theories.
